title: Auth0 Forms MCP
name: auth0-forms-mcp
author: mustafadeel
description: Expose an Auth0 Form as an MCP App over Streamable HTTP.

AUTH0_TENANT_ORIGIN.description: Optional canonical Auth0 tenant origin override. Defaults to the tenant domain supplied to this extension.

FORM_ID.description: Auth0 Form identifier exposed by this MCP server, for example ap_abc123.

AUTH0_FORMS_TRUST_SECRET.description: Shared secret used to mint trusted session tokens for a session-aware Form.

AUTH0_AUDIENCE.description: Optional external MCP audience override. By default the extension provisions and uses its installed MCP endpoint URL.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Optional public OAuth proxy origin, for example https://forms-mcp.example.com. Do not include a trailing slash.

FORMS_ORIGIN.description: Optional custom domain that serves the Auth0 Forms bundle. Defaults to AUTH0_TENANT_ORIGIN.

FORM_NAME.description: Optional friendly name used in the MCP tool name.

FORM_DESCRIPTION.description: Optional instruction that tells the agent when to invoke this Form.
FORM_DESCRIPTION.example: Open this form when the user wants to set up their company profile.

FORM_SESSION_FIELD.description: Hidden Form field that receives a trusted session token. Leave empty for a no-session Form.

MCP_AUTH.description: Set to off only for a no-session development Form. Auth0 Bearer authentication is enabled by default.
